title: Stir Fry with Crispy Sweet Potato
description: A simple and delicious stir fry dish with crispy sweet potato, perfect for a quick weeknight dinner. This recipe combines Asian-inspired flavors with a crunchy twist.

ingredients.name: Crunchy Stir Fry Mix (Chinese Broccoli & Carrots)

instructions: Heat the cooking oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced sweet potato and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until tender and slightly browned.
Add the crunchy stir fry mix, umami sauce, soy sauce, ginger, and garlic to the skillet. Stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender-crisp.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately, garnished with chopped green onions or sesame seeds if desired.
